(2) reviewFixes[tid].dispatched is now the list of start keys whose dispatch carried the findings (hand_back writes []; legacy true reads as one dispatch via _fix_dispatched); review_fix returns the entry for every dispatch while the hand-back stands, so a retry (new start) or a stale-brief re-issue carries the findings; only the first dispatch may resume the warm session, later ones start fresh with brief + findings.
